about: LFM3-1.7B (MLX · 8-bit, Liquid AI's own export) on mlx-vlm 0.7.12's server at the model's full 262,144 window, one request at a time, thinking on by default. mlx-lm cannot load LFM3 yet (ml-explore/mlx-lm#2016). Prefill runs in 128-token steps: with mlx-vlm's default 2,048 macOS stopped prompts of 32K and more on this laptop (kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorImpactingInteractivity), and the smaller step costs no speed. MLX_VLM_TOKEN_QUEUE_TIMEOUT is raised because a prompt that fills the window takes longer to read than mlx-vlm's 600 s limit. Lab on an M1 Max with the 32-core GPU: 101.2 tok/s decode, 508 tok/s prefill over a 184,722-token prompt, 5.38 GiB peak. Of Liquid AI's three MLX exports, 8-bit decodes 1.6x as fast as bf16 (102 against 63 tok/s at 8K) with the same prefill and stays within 0.0037 nats of it; 4-bit is faster again (131) but 0.257 nats away. About 2 GB of weights.
install: python3 -m pip install mlx-vlm==0.7.12 mlx==0.32.4 transformers==5.22.2 huggingface_hub==2.4.0 (macOS on Apple silicon, Python >= 3.10)
